parallax._doc: 3D backgrounds (0.083, core/bg3d.js): depth maps in assets/bg/depth/ (tools/gen-depth.py). depthScale = how far depth pushes the art along each camera ray; pivot = the depth that stays still; yaw/pitch = sway amplitude in degrees; periods in seconds; overscan = skirt beyond the screen edge; overrides = per-file tweaks keyed by background filename. joltDeg = the small camera kick on heavy blows; swayDeg = the rocking rotation (about the depth centre) on the biggest blows (0.092/0.093; crits, SMASH, multi-kills swing the near art right, hits on the knight of at least swayHitShare of max HP swing it left). depthFiles = per-background depth map filename when regenerated (new name, never overwrite). fog (0.099; puffs 0.101, core/bg3dPuffs.js) = depth-embedded mist: distance haze + large soft mist puffs drifting through the scene volume; amount per background in overrides (long exterior views more, rooms a touch), colour from the scene's own far pixels (fogColor [r,g,b] 0-1 overrides it). fogWind = drift in world units/s [sideways +right, up, toward the camera +] per background; fogSpeed multiplies it. puffs = count, size range, height range (y), box half-width, near/far distance (the art spans ~0.6-1.4; the focal plane is 1) with fading bands, soft = how gently a puff fades into the scene in front of it, opacity. maxPixels = canvas pixel budget; minFps = below this the quality steps down (lower resolution, then no fog, then flat). lights (0.100, core/bg3dLights.js) = the flash a crit / potion / revive puts into the scene in front of the character: dist = how far in front of the camera (focal plane 1), radius = reach in world units, per kind colour, strength, fade and life in seconds; enabled false switches them off.
